item.title: Israel Says It Killed a Hezbollah Chief Near Beirut, Testing the Truce
item.description: The strike was the first near the Lebanese capital since a cease-fire that has curbed fighting but not halted it. Washington is pushing for a lasting peace, hoping it will ease diplomacy with Iran.

item.title: Photo shows Israeli soldier desecrating a Virgin Mary statue in Lebanon
item.description: The Israeli military says it has launched an investigation after a photo showing one of its soldiers desecrating a statue of the Virgin Mary in South Lebanon went viral, as he placed a cigarette into the statue's mouth whilst smoking. The IDF said it "respects freedom of religion" and that the soldier will be disciplined. The incident took place Debel, in the same village where last month, an Israeli soldier was filmed smashing a Jesus statue with a sledgehammer.

item.title: Keeping the Lebanese army weak: A hardened US military doctrine at Israel's service
item.description: As Lebanon marks a month since “Black Wednesday”, when massive Israeli strikes killed 361 people, the international community continues to call on the Lebanese army to disarm Hezbollah. But the US legal imperative to ensure Israel has a “qualitative military edge” (QME) has kept the Lebanese military under-funded, under-equipped and unable to perform its role.

item.title: US war on Iran: 'A game of high risk, high reward' for both Trump and the Islamic Republic
item.description: Mark Owen is pleased to welcome Behnam Ben Taleblu, Iran Program Senior Director and Senior Fellow at the Foundation for Defense of Democracies. He presents the escalating confrontation between Iran and the United States as a dangerous and evolving contest of "high risk, high reward." item.description: A confidential intelligence community assessment delivered to the White House also finds that Iran retains a substantial missile and drone arsenal.

item.title: Trump and Xi set to meet under shadow of Iran negotiations
item.description: President Donald Trump wants a lavish welcome in Beijing for a summit with Xi Jinping next week. But the specter of the war in Iran looms large.

item.title: Iran Nobel Peace Prize winner Narges Mohammadi 'between life and death'
item.description: Jailed Iranian Nobel Peace Prize winner Narges Mohammadi is fighting for her life after being hospitalised under guard for the last five days with a heart condition.

item.title: German Leaders Clash With Spy Chiefs Over Domestic Threat From Iran
item.description: Intelligence agents have privately warned of the potential of hybrid attacks from Iran-linked groups. But political leaders, including Chancellor Friedrich Merz, have publicly played down the risk.

item.title: Iran reviews U.S. proposal. And, Rubio to meet Pope Leo after Trump's criticism
item.description: Iran is reviewing the Trump administration's latest proposal to end the war. And, Secretary of State Marco Rubio is meeting Pope Leo XIV amid President Trump's harsh criticism of him.
